notes: FAILED_PRECONDITION (HTTP 400 in google/rpc/code.proto): the API refuses callers in an unsupported region, or a free-tier project where billing must be enabled. Not recordable from a supported region. The error body is google.rpc.Status in its HTTP JSON mapping ({"error": {code, message, status, details}}); status names and their HTTP codes come from googleapis google/rpc/code.proto, details from google/rpc/error_details.proto and google/api/error_reason.proto (read 2026-10-28).

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap G20: mapGeminiStatus maps by the status string and knows only INVALID_ARGUMENT, UNAUTHENTICATED, PERMISSION_DENIED, NOT_FOUND and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; FAILED_PRECONDITION becomes a 502, which the gateway retries, fails over and counts against the circuit breaker, although the request can never succeed
